course_sale_dates_check.name: course_sale_dates_check
course_sale_dates_check.value: "my_schema"."course"."sale_start_at" IS NULL OR "my_schema"."course"."sale_expires_at" IS NULL OR "my_schema"."course"."sale_expires_at" > "my_schema"."course"."sale_start_at"

course_review_reviewed_at_check.name: course_review_reviewed_at_check
course_review_reviewed_at_check.value: "my_schema"."course_review"."approved" = true OR ("my_schema"."course_review"."approved" = false AND "my_schema"."course_review"."reviewed_at" IS NULL)

enrollment_payment_invoice_check.name: enrollment_payment_invoice_check
enrollment_payment_invoice_check.value: "my_schema"."enrollment"."enrollment_type" = 'individual' OR ("my_schema"."enrollment"."enrollment_type" != 'individual' AND "my_schema"."enrollment"."payment_id" IS NULL AND "my_schema"."enrollment"."invoice_id" IS NULL)

enrollment_team_license_check.name: enrollment_team_license_check
enrollment_team_license_check.value: "my_schema"."enrollment"."enrollment_type" = 'team' OR ("my_schema"."enrollment"."enrollment_type" != 'team' AND "my_schema"."enrollment"."team_license_id" IS NULL AND "my_schema"."enrollment"."team_invite_id" IS NULL)

payment_bulk_quantity_required_check.name: payment_bulk_quantity_required_check
payment_bulk_quantity_required_check.value:
(
        "my_schema"."payment"."purchase_type" = 'team'
        AND "my_schema"."payment"."bulk_quantity" IN (10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40)
      ) OR (
        "my_schema"."payment"."purchase_type" <> 'team'
        AND "my_schema"."payment"."bulk_quantity" IS NULL
      )

payment_gift_email_required_check.name: payment_gift_email_required_check
payment_gift_email_required_check.value:
("my_schema"."payment"."is_gift" = false AND "my_schema"."payment"."gift_recipient_email" IS NULL)
        OR ("my_schema"."payment"."is_gift" = true AND "my_schema"."payment"."gift_recipient_email" IS NOT NULL)

payment_gift_redeem_token_check.name: payment_gift_redeem_token_check
payment_gift_redeem_token_check.value:
("my_schema"."payment"."is_gift" = false AND "my_schema"."payment"."gift_redeem_token" IS NULL)
        OR ("my_schema"."payment"."is_gift" = true AND "my_schema"."payment"."gift_redeem_token" IS NOT NULL)

payment_gift_redeem_url_check.name: payment_gift_redeem_url_check
payment_gift_redeem_url_check.value:
("my_schema"."payment"."is_gift" = false AND "my_schema"."payment"."gift_redeem_url" IS NULL)
        OR ("my_schema"."payment"."is_gift" = true AND "my_schema"."payment"."gift_redeem_url" IS NOT NULL)

support_ticket_resolution_check.name: support_ticket_resolution_check
support_ticket_resolution_check.value: ("my_schema"."support_ticket"."status" = 'resolved' AND "my_schema"."support_ticket"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("my_schema"."support_ticket"."status" != 'resolved' AND "my_schema"."support_ticket"."resolved_at" IS NULL)

support_ticket_closure_check.name: support_ticket_closure_check
support_ticket_closure_check.value: ("my_schema"."support_ticket"."status" = 'closed' AND "my_schema"."support_ticket"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("my_schema"."support_ticket"."status" != 'closed' AND "my_schema"."support_ticket"."closed_at" IS NULL)

team_license_invite_acceptance_check.name: team_license_invite_acceptance_check
team_license_invite_acceptance_check.value:
("my_schema"."team_license_invite"."status" = 'claimed' AND "my_schema"."team_license_invite"."accepted_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("my_schema"."team_license_invite"."status" <> 'claimed' AND "my_schema"."team_license_invite"."accepted_by_user_id" IS NULL)

team_license_invite_revocation_check.name: team_license_invite_revocation_check
team_license_invite_revocation_check.value:
("my_schema"."team_license_invite"."status" = 'revoked' AND "my_schema"."team_license_invite"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "my_schema"."team_license_invite"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("my_schema"."team_license_invite"."status" <> 'revoked' AND "my_schema"."team_license_invite"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "my_schema"."team_license_invite"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
